guardrail: Every family re-optimizes alpha, beta, C_tes, L, and T_bath at fixed R_TES=1.25 times the inherited resistance. Readout parameters are effective order-2 magnitude-shape coordinates only. The c2-only and pole_frequency_plus_c2 cases are branch diagnostics; the main nested ladder is fixed_reference_readout -> pole_frequency_only -> pole_section -> pole_section_plus_c2 -> full_order2. A residual readout degree being necessary does not identify a physical electronics component.
